references.text: Both verses highlight the theme of an honorable death and a peaceful burial as a gift from God, even though one is a concrete agreement and the other a prophetic promise.
Clear thematic parallel: The promise of a peaceful death and an honorable burial for a righteous man.
The same prophetic motif as in 2 Chronicles 34:28: The promise of a peaceful death and burial for a righteous leader.
Thematic parallel: A foreign patriarch (Abraham/Isaac) who is treated with respect and granted peace by local leaders through an agreement.
